evidence.quote: I will start by acknowledging that inflation has been too high for too long.
While I view the risks to both economic activity and employment as roughly balanced at this point, I see upside risks to inflation.
I will continue to assess whether underlying trends suggest that inflation will return to target with sufficient speed.
I see economic activity and labor market conditions remaining broadly solid while inflation remains above our target.

This was an important step to ensure longer-term inflation expectations remain well anchored and to validate the public's confidence that we will achieve our 2 percent inflation objective in a timely manner.
